cards.name: Lightwheel Enhancements
cards.oracle_text:
Enchant creature or Vehicle
Start your engines! (If you have no speed, it starts at 1. It increases once on each of your turns when an opponent loses life. Max speed is 4.)
Enchanted permanent gets +1/+1 and has vigilance.
Max speed — You may cast this card from your graveyard.

cards.name: Knighted Myr
cards.oracle_text:
{2}{W}: Adapt 1. (If this creature has no +1/+1 counters on it, put a +1/+1 counter on it.)
Whenever one or more +1/+1 counters are put on this creature, it gains double strike until end of turn.

cards.name: Might of the Ancestors
cards.oracle_text: At the beginning of combat on your turn, target creature you control gets +2/+0 and gains vigilance until end of turn.

cards.name: Inventive Wingsmith
cards.oracle_text: At the beginning of your end step, if you haven't cast a spell from your hand this turn and this creature doesn't have a flying counter on it, put a flying counter on it.

cards.name: Sunspire Gatekeepers
cards.oracle_text: When this creature enters, if you control two or more Gates, create a 2/2 white Knight creature token with vigilance.

cards.name: Exorcise
cards.oracle_text: Exile target artifact, enchantment, or creature with power 4 or greater.

cards.name: Timely Hordemate
cards.oracle_text: Raid — When this creature enters, if you attacked this turn, return target creature card with mana value 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.

cards.name: Cult Healer
cards.oracle_text: Eerie — Whenever an enchantment you control enters and whenever you fully unlock a Room, this creature gains lifelink until end of turn.
